timing_verdict.label: NEUTRAL
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1400 KRW/USD (currently, with 1300s expected by year-end)

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly (150 KRW drop over two months), making USD more expensive to buy right now. However, news suggests the won may continue strengthening toward 1300s by year-end, meaning if you wait, dollars could become even cheaper—but this requires the trend to hold.

TIP: Consider splitting your monthly $2,000 conversion into smaller weekly purchases to average out timing risk, rather than trying to time one large monthly conversion.
